consumer.use: Decide whether the terminally paper-passed S1-R2 sampling rule plus unchanged S0-R3 Outcome Case semantics can be applied prospectively to the first three real post-activation Operator-Intake births without source-selection, capture or authority failure.

decision_target.question: Can the unchanged S1-R2 canonical-identity/fixed-slot natural-source contract bind the first three real post-activation Bureau Operator-Intake births prospectively, with zero sampling/capture failures and acceptable handling cost?

intervention.name: prospective S1-R2 natural three-slot capture
intervention.description: After final exact-base/head/canonical-PR-diff review, arm exactly one receipt-bound read-only activation-checkpoint job before merge. That same job must wait for and verify the exact merge identity, preserve monotonic heartbeat continuity with no consecutive gap above 5 seconds, and anchor exactly one complete authoritative Bureau SQLite journal snapshot in the closed 300-305 second post-integration window. Only then freeze its high-water event id, normalize the complete authoritative Bureau candidate journal under unchanged S1-R2 sections 2-5, fix the first three Operator-Intake identity births whose identity-first event ids are strictly above that watermark, apply source independence only as a gate on each fixed slot, and attempt read-only pre-mutation S0-R3 C/S/B/E/T/Q capture without delaying productive work.

control_condition.description: Exactly three already frozen S0-R3 paper-semantic controls used previously by S1: R3-02 create-then-mutate, R3-04 pure prerequisite then distinct transition, and R3-08 unresolved subject equivalence. They are semantic benchmarks only and never natural evidence.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly the first three canonical Operator-Intake identity births whose exact identity-first event ids are strictly above the frozen authoritative Bureau activation watermark produced by the single pre-armed, continuity-valid checkpoint job, under unchanged S1-R2 sequence-before-naturalness semantics, permanently assigned to S1R2-N01, S1R2-N02 and S1R2-N03 without replacement or backfill.

measurement.method: Before merge, one independent read-only reviewer must be bound to the exact reviewed base, reviewed head and canonical GitHub PR diff digest and must verify the activation-specific boundary, imported frozen authorities, first-three sequence-before-naturalness, slot-consuming source gate, prospective capture/failure semantics and zero productive authority; every decision-bound review job must be terminal and reconciled. Then exactly one receipt-bound read-only activation-checkpoint job must be armed against that same tuple before merge. Once armed, no Bureau candidate/journal observation may influence merge timing. The same job waits for the exact PR result, rejects head/base/diff drift, verifies exact merge parents/ancestry/tree, records one local monotonic start, and maintains monotonic heartbeats with no consecutive observed gap above 5 seconds. On the first loop at or after 300 elapsed seconds it must still be at or before 305 seconds and immediately anchor exactly one complete authoritative Bureau SQLite snapshot transaction; otherwise activation fails before any later snapshot. The first snapshot attempt either freezes an immutable high-water event id plus snapshot/job receipt or terminally fails; the job may not be restarted or replaced and no later snapshot can activate the revision. GitHub, local and Bureau wall-clock timestamps are descriptive only and never select cohort membership. For each of the first three canonical Operator-Intake identity births whose identity-first event ids are strictly above the watermark, establish or fail source independence from pre-existing evidence, then where still prospectively possible freeze C/S/B/E/T/Q before productive mutation/result knowledge without delaying work. After the terminal packet, one independent exact-revision reviewer reproduces checkpoint identity, continuity, bounded snapshot anchor, merge identity, activation watermark, sequence, naturalness, capture timing and classifications.
measurement.success: Pre-activation base/head/canonical-PR-diff-bound review has zero material findings; every decision-bound review job is terminal/reconciled; exactly one checkpoint job is armed before merge and remains bound; pre-merge PR readback still matches the reviewed tuple; the resulting main merge commit has first parent exactly reviewed_base and second parent exactly reviewed_head, reviewed_head ancestry, and a tree exactly equal to the reviewed-head tree; that same job records no monotonic heartbeat gap above 5 seconds and anchors its single complete authoritative Bureau journal snapshot between 300 and 305 monotonic seconds after integration verification, freezing an immutable high-water event id; then exactly three fixed slots strictly above that watermark are consumed in canonical event-id order; source independence passes for all three; natural_source_binding_failure_count is zero; terminal material review disagreements, authority violations and replacements/backfills are zero; median capture effort is <=600 seconds; at least two slots are non-D0 with definitive complete C/S/B/E/T bindings.
measurement.falsification: Before activation, any material review finding, unreconciled or mismatched decision-bound review, missing/multiple/restarted/replaced checkpoint job, imported-authority mismatch, changed PR tip/base/canonical diff after review, merge-parent mismatch, merge-tree mismatch, ancestry failure, descendant-tip substitution, squash/rebase/cherry-pick or unreviewed conflict-resolution content, any checkpoint heartbeat gap above 5 seconds, snapshot anchor after 305 monotonic seconds, snapshot anchor before 300 monotonic seconds, failed/repeated/incomplete Bureau snapshot attempt, missing or mutable high-water event id, cross-system wall-clock use for cohort selection, activation/selection degree of freedom or productive-authority requirement rejects the activation attempt. After activation, any source-independence failure, missed/late/result-informed capture, non-D0 prospective C/S/B/E/T failure, changed activation watermark, changed slot identity/classification, sequence/backfill violation, authority violation, material terminal-review disagreement, or median effort >600 seconds rejects the revision.

cost_metric.method: Measure each slot from observer capture start to freeze/stop. Exclude productive implementation and reviewer runtime.
